title: FinOps Lab | estimaciones hipotéticas y auditoría

panels.title: Último escenario hipotético: antes y después (USD estimado, no factura AWS)

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT resource_id, recorded_at FROM cost_scenarios WHERE source = 'estimate' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT c.scenario AS escenario, c.resource_id AS recurso_hipotetico, c.hours AS horas, c.hourly_usd AS tarifa_usd_h, round(c.hourly_usd * c.hours, 4) AS costo_estimado_usd FROM cost_scenarios c JOIN latest l ON c.resource_id = l.resource_id AND c.recorded_at = l.recorded_at WHERE c.source = 'estimate' ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.scenario = 'antes' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

SELECT recorded_at AS time, scenario AS metric, sum(hourly_usd * hours)::double precision AS value FROM cost_scenarios WHERE source = 'estimate' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT occurred_at, action, resource_id, mode, result FROM audit_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
